description: Exclusive to Projectors and Reflectors with no defined centres below the throat. Environment and people are the authority.
decision_style: Move through different environments and speak with different trusted people. Notice how your body feels in each context. The right decision becomes clear through environmental comparison rather than analysis.
time_to_decide: After sampling multiple perspectives and environments. Not a quick authority.
career_application: Before accepting a role, visit the physical environment if possible. Notice how your body responds. Speak with people in different roles about the opportunity. Your environment literally affects your wellbeing.
common_mistake: Trying to make decisions in isolation or through mental analysis alone.
